npcs.name: Varric | Gate watch
npcs.dialogue: Keep the lanterns in sight. The inn is beyond the stone arch, and the quartermaster keeps her stall across the court. The mine road leaves by the southern gate.
npcs.service_hint: Courtyard study: conversations are free. Town services remain in the existing campaign hub.

npcs.name: Mara | Quartermaster
npcs.dialogue: A sound blade and dry provisions will serve you better than promises. Check every hand and strap before taking the road.
npcs.service_hint: Trading Post integration is planned; this preview cannot buy, sell or change equipment.

npcs.name: Oren | The Lantern Inn
npcs.dialogue: The hearth is still warm. Come back from the mine in one piece and there will be a place for your company.
npcs.service_hint: Inn entry and normal5gold recovery remain in campaign services; no recovery occurs in this study.
